vc_checking.summary: All three cleaned manual obligations are semantically provable under the frozen circular doubly-linked-list specification. The entry entailment splits xizi_dll immediately before the designated node; return_wit_1 rebuilds the nonempty-prefix segment after inserting the fresh node; return_wit_2 directly folds the empty-prefix case. One proof group is the exact minimal coverage because all targets use the same dll/dllseg split-and-splice family.

proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: First prove the two group-suffixed generic helper lemmas by structural induction on the logical prefix, using only dll/dllseg unfolding, explicit existential construction, direct field cancellation, and constructor pure guards. For entail_wit_1, apply the focus helper, frame both fresh cells, and prove fresh-node inequalities by explicit points-to exclusivity. For return_wit_1, choose the second Coq disjunct, fold the inserted node and target into a two-node continuation segment, apply the splice helper at prev, and normalize PreH7. For return_wit_2, choose the first Coq disjunct, substitute the empty-prefix equalities, instantiate xizi_dll endpoints, and fold two dllseg constructors directly.
proof_groups.proof_strategy: Forbidden-free constructive separation proof: use structural induction, predicate unfold/fold, Intros/Exists, explicit pure rewrites, and audited sep_apply/direct cancellation steps. Do not use any forbidden lemma, black-box entailment shortcut, generated-file modification, witness-statement change, Admitted, or Axiom.
